authority_basis.summary: Send Nima the C4 Hessian-support result.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the C4 node Hessian carrier test
operations.body: Entry 1165/event 924 closes the deeper C4 node-support audit. Exact derivation covers all 296 labelled records and yields 28 Hessian types. The 152 coordinate occurrences factor into products/squares of adj(G)-linear Gram-cofactor forms. The 144 alternating occurrences give four labelled two-plane minors of adj(G); by Jacobi each is det(G) times a complementary Gram 1-minor. Thus no new irreducible carrier divisor occurs. The remaining question is physical activation of the anti-invariant node coefficient classes by a source-relative specialization map.
